literal: Disease having examined, disease cause having examined, that which mitigates method having examined, fittingly act.
translation: Examine the disease, examine its root cause, examine the method that cures it, and then act effectively.
modern: நோயை ஆராய்ந்து, அந்த நோய்க்கான காரணத்தை ஆராய்ந்து, அதனைத் தீர்க்கும் வழியையும் ஆராய்ந்து, பொருந்தும் படி மருத்துவம் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the systematic approach required to treat an illness. First, one must diagnose the disease itself, and then investigate its underlying cause. Next, one must determine the proper method to cure it. The word வாய் here means the way or method of treatment, rather than its common meaning of mouth. Finally, the treatment must be applied effectively and fittingly to ensure a complete cure.
